messages:
morgan: FYI we're scheduling a staggered maintenance for us-east2 slate-gpu-pool on 2026-04-10 23:00 -> 2026-04-11 01:30 UTC. Objective: PCIe microcode update + NVLink rescan + thermal calibration. We'll do two-node batches to keep steady throughput. Ops please ack.

ryan: ack. what's the exact impact on burstable capacity? and are dedicated tenants impacted?

morgan: Expect ~15% transient capacity reduction during batch handoffs. Dedicated pinned tenants are unchanged. Hosted burst traffic may queue briefly; we'll route overflow to slate-backup-pool if thresholds exceed 70% queue depth.

anika: Canary flow proposal: gpu-slate-22 first. If healthy for 20m, proceed with 2-node batches (22+23, 24+25...). We'll do a 10m pause between batches for telemetry.

sara: Suggest pre-warming KV + prefix prefetch for /embeddings and /session-state. Also run a quick eviction-scan pre-check to ensure memory pressure low before drain.

ops-oncall: I'll be on the channel from start. If a reboot exceeds 8m to come back, I'll pause the run and escalate.

maintenance-bot: Maintenance window created: 2026-04-10T23:00:00Z -> 2026-04-11T01:30:00Z (ID: mw-1849999999). Notifications to oncall and affected teams scheduled.

morgan: Minimal runbook snippet to copy:
```
# canary
kubectl cordon gpu-slate-22
kubectl drain gpu-slate-22 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=90
run-thermal-calibrate --node gpu-slate-22 --profile slate-v1
apply-pcie-microcode --node gpu-slate-22 --version 3.0.2 --verify
nvlink-rescan --node gpu-slate-22
reboot-node gpu-slate-22 --timeout 300
healthcheck --node gpu-slate-22 --checks pcie, nvlink, gpu-temp, driver-logs
kubectl uncordon gpu-slate-22
# on fail: rollback microcode, mark node 'manual-investigate'
```

ryan: We'll also tag nodes with microcode after success: `kubectl annotate node gpu-slate-22 redwood/pcie_v=3.0.2`

anika: For KV warmup:
```
slate-cache-preheat --pool slate-gpu-pool --prefix "/embeddings" --parallel 6
slate-cache-preheat --pool slate-gpu-pool --prefix "/session-state" --parallel 3
```

sara: Cost estimate if overflow routing used: approx $2.1k for 2.5h (preemptible nodes + egress). Ryan please route finance ping.

ryan: Pinged finance. If approved we'll enable slate-backup-pool routing for bursts >75% queue depth.

ops-oncall: Metrics to watch: p50, p95 latency, queue depth, tokens/sec, GPU memory evictions/min, GPU temp > 85C alerts. I'll add temporary dashboards.

morgan: Communication plan: status banner at T-30m, automated slack reminder to #customer-success at T-15m, and email to top-5 tenants. console message: "slate-gpu-pool maintenance".

anika: Can we shorten to 1h if everything green after first two batches? ops-oncall?

ops-oncall: We can compress to 60m total if first two batches pass health checks and p95 stays within 20% of baseline. Otherwise stick to full window.

maintenance-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m pre-notify at 2026-04-10T22:30:00Z.

morgan: After each successful batch we'll snapshot perf (p50/p95/throughput) and annotate runbook with node IDs. I'll post runbook link here a few hours before start.

ryan: One last ask: enable verbose driver logs for 15m after each uncordon and collect `dmesg` + `nvidia-smi -q` to S3 path s3://redwood-ops/maintenance/us-east2/1849999999/

morgan: noted. I'll add log collection steps. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
